supported_measurement: native link entry/exit at solver-step resolution
limitation: Native exit times and derived next-link entry are quantized to original 1-second SUMO solver step; continuous crossing unknown
freeze_disposition: Nonblocking only if primary timing outcome explicitly uses step-resolution events
required_action: Publish step-aligned entry definition and report quantization/support differences

supported_measurement: SUMO aggregate road presence and FCD front-snapshot descriptions
limitation: Native road body presence and FCD front lane samples need not agree numerically due to different semantics and overlap
freeze_disposition: Nonblocking when native road occupancy and FCD front-positions remain separate outcomes; blocks direct FCD-native forecast MAE
required_action: Declare source roles and exclude unlike-unit subtraction from predictor accuracy

supported_measurement: direct prior path-assignment reads inside route search
limitation: Search counter increments planned path assignments in one time bin; no forecast in physical vehicle-seconds or occupied road percent
freeze_disposition: Explicitly exclude physical occupancy predictor accuracy unless a new separately authorized pre-SUMO forecast is designed
required_action: Replace 'occupancy forecast accuracy' with assignment proxy association or new like-for-like forecast protocol

supported_measurement: simulation-step external entry events on driven route
limitation: Native-exit-derived entry timestamps and first/last edge joins not yet systematically compared with prior FCD entry over three regimes
required_action: Implement development-only paired native-entry vs FCD first-sample bridge keyed by vehicle and ordinal, preserving missingness

limitation: Only high-congestion development simulations with native events have been subjected to full invariance checks
freeze_disposition: Blocks assertion of native event reference verified for all three congestion regimes
required_action: Run same existing development scenarios moderate and low with pinned image, compare all tripinfo and route entries

limitation: Elapsed time on internal junction links includes waiting and movement; no counterfactual signal-free service time identified
freeze_disposition: Exclude causal junction delay claim; nonblocking for observed internal residence
required_action: Keep separate names for internal residence and excess causal delay; latter requires new intervention design

limitation: Exact occupancy lookup provenance verified on inspected 200-second development seeds only
freeze_disposition: Blocks full cross-regime search-input provenance claim
required_action: Replay original moderate and low development seeds with sink ON/OFF, audit revisions, route/audit identical

supported_measurement: time-aware vs freeflow edge-entry timing on chosen routes
limitation: Current model systematically predicts earlier arrivals than observed, especially under high congestion
freeze_disposition: Does not prevent measurement freeze; blocks claims of validated predictor accuracy
required_action: Report error per seed and regime including absolute and signed bias; do not choose favorable threshold post hoc

limitation: No measured real-world link flows, weather, incidents, travel demand or traffic signal calibration
freeze_disposition: Always exclude real-world traffic efficacy safety or generalization
required_action: Frame all estimands and claims explicitly as synthetic SUMO-specific

supported_measurement: SUMO 30-second native edgeData sampledSeconds and occupancy
limitation: Partial final intervals, absent fields on empty roads, small sampledSeconds rounded to zero and aggregation semantics need explicit denominator handling
freeze_disposition: Blocks occupancy comparisons until bins and missingness are codified
required_action: Write half-open bin and native field schema; separate not-applicable, zero and missing; validate native-simulator settings

supported_measurement: search candidates versus actually driven routes
limitation: Search recorded costs for candidate paths but SUMO observed outcomes exist only for chosen routes
freeze_disposition: Exclude counterfactual candidate realized durations and optimal-policy claims
required_action: Design later paired intervention study separately if desired

supported_measurement: per-scenario original code and immutable input archives
limitation: Compressed search event streams stored temporarily in Actions rather than durable GitHub; reproducibility depends on run artifacts, image digest and versioned scripts
freeze_disposition: Prerequisite to M3: versioned generators, code/input hashes and regeneration recipe published
required_action: Pin source SHA, immutable image, per-run hashes; preserve sufficient reference evidence and reproducible script

limitation: Tripinfo completion and observed route match do not alone certify absence of teleports, skipped internal links or exceptional arrivals for all future datasets
freeze_disposition: Define explicit exception handling and fail closed on unknown contamination
required_action: Prespecify departed/arrived/teleport/route-change accounting and duplicate/out-of-order event flags

supported_measurement: published FCD entry MAE vs native step entry error
limitation: Published prior MAE reflects first-seen one-second FCD external front not native-inferred entry step
freeze_disposition: Blocks relabeling earlier MAEs as native timing accuracy
required_action: Generate development-only paired FCD/native bridge and report the two references side by side without overwriting history
